component.name: NotePad
component.summary: A native Qt 6 clone of Microsoft Notepad

description.p: NotePad is a lightweight plain-text editor that recreates the classic Microsoft Notepad (Windows XP) experience using Qt 6, with support for light and dark modes following the Kirigami color guidelines.
This is an independent implementation and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.

ul.li: Open, edit, and save plain text files
Cut, copy, paste, undo, and redo
Find, replace, and go to a line number
Choose an editor font from the Format menu
Word wrap toggle and a live line/column status bar
Insert the current time and date (F5)
System, light, and dark color schemes

description.p: Rewritten on Qt 6. Light and dark theming now follows the Kirigami color guidelines: the app honors the system color scheme by default and can be pinned to a light or dark scheme from the View menu.
Initial release of the GTK4 NotePad clone.
